text:
Type: irregular patchwork jute rug
Use: anchoring a seating area, statement floor piece; living room, dining room, study
Style: contemporary, bohemian, Scandinavian
Materials: natural jute-like plant fibre flatweave, red edge binding
Colors: warm natural tan, black grid lines, bright red edges
Shape: four offset rectangular panels forming a stepped irregular outline, black windowpane and stripe grids in varying scales, flat, large
Feel: artful, earthy, quirky, relaxed
Goes with: light wood, white walls, black metal, red accents; eclectic, Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.name: TERNSLEV
product.description: Twist, turn and play around with the shape of this hard-wearing rug until you find the perfect spot in your home.
